title: Revitalization Of A Distant Land
paragraphs: “Let go of me! I…I must kill the Shield and those fake heroes who side with him! Let go! Are you really citizens of Melromarc?! Martiiiiiiiiii!”

I quietly approached and jabbed the struggling scum in the forehead with a Paralyze Lance. Twitching and convulsing, the scum collapsed. Paralyzed, he was dragged away. You’re not done yet, so stay quiet.
“W-what in the world…?”
“Come to think of it, the castle was noisy before we got here.”
“What happened?”
“Mother, what’s going on?”
The Queen, looking at the scum, sighed and turned her gaze to Father and the others.
“…The soldiers who escaped with the pig abandoned her and disappeared. As for the scum, he must have connected this incident to the fact that you heroes were here and charged in.”
“Sister…” Fiancée muttered in dismay.
Hahaha! The assassination was a complete success.
“Well, if they didn’t die, that’s good enough, right?”
“Indeed. As long as they remain in a state of shock and don’t cause any more trouble, it’s a good thing.”
The Queen nodded as if fully agreeing. Don’t worry. I’ve already dealt with the pig’s soul. Most likely, that pig will remain in that state forever.
“We’re talking about the future, aren’t we? I heard a bit about it yesterday.”
“Isn’t there something urgent that needs to be done?”
“Hmm… Even if we’re going to level up, we should gather forces first.”

Even if I were to power level Father and the others, I can’t do it alone. What needs to be done first is securing the presence of the Filolial queen. As for Father and the others, perhaps we should assign the slaves from the village Father cultivated, as per the orders from the sister. There was talk of gathering them to help with the village’s restoration.
“Motoyasu, you blew up all your companions, didn’t you?”
“Blew up? Who are you talking about?”
I have no idea what they’re talking about. There’s no way I would do something so inhumane.
“They’re talking about the people who were your companions until yesterday.”
“Ah, those who turned against us in every world. They were never my companions.”
“You’re being pretty blunt…”
“Of course. Then how about this? Let’s call them early-game guest participants.”
“That’s such an awkwardly game-like way to put it…”
Father looked displeased. After returning to his normal expression, he continued.
“We can’t have Rifana-chan and Raphtalia-chan fight, but we do need allies.”
At that moment, the friend who was holding hands with the sister nudged Father’s arm to assert herself.
“Um… I want to become stronger. Yes. Ahem.”
The sister’s friend seems quite motivated. Though she still hasn’t fully recovered, so she’ll need to rest before she can fight.
“Eh…”
The sister, on the other hand, looks surprised.
“Um, first of all, could we ask you to help with the restoration of the village where Raphtalia-chan and Rifana-chan lived?”
Father made the request to the Queen.
“Motoyasu-san, what about securing companions? Rifana-san and Raphtalia-san alone wouldn’t be enough.”
“Why do you think it’s just those two? Of course, I’ll arrange for them.”
“Hmph. Don’t tell me you’re talking about Filolials?”
What are they even saying? Of course, it’s the Filolial queens. Ren and Itsuki looked exasperated at my expression.
Did they figure it out?
“Filolial queens are angels! If I raise them, they’ll become strong in no time and make Father and the others invincible!”
“Okay, okay.”

“Since we can’t really separate from Motoyasu-san within Melromarc anyway. Honestly, anywhere is fine, even Zeltoble, as long as we can fight in a place where the Three Hero Church’s assassins won’t come.”
“That will take time, I say.”
It’s all about how quickly Father and the others can grow stronger. At that moment, the Queen raised her hand.
“Kitamura-dono.”
“What is it?”
“Kitamura-dono, can you move to various places across the world?”
“Of course. I’ve pretty much covered everything. I secured them during the previous loops.”
In the last loop, thanks to cooperating with Father and the others, I managed to secure almost all the portals. Though, of course, I’ve limited it to areas around the major nations.
“Then how about heading to the Dracia Mountain Range, which is currently in an action state?”
Oh? Is an activation event occurring?
“Activation?”
“It’s an experience boost event. I’ve never heard of it happening around this time.”
“Since it’s a remote region far from our kingdom, it’s likely that by the time anyone reaches there, the event is already over.”
Ah, I see. If it’s being held somewhere that’s hard to reach, whether by foot or even with the Filolial queens, there’s usually no point in going.
“So it’s already ongoing?”
“If Motoyasu’s portal can get us close, it’s worth going.”
“But the problem is that there are quite a few people in this world who want to kill the heroes.”
I explained to them about the reincarnators and teleporters I learned about during the last loop. Father called them the vanguard of the gods.
“If we’re up against enemies like that, there’s no guarantee they won’t be there.”
“But they weren’t at Cal Mira Island, right?”
“Melromarc is still considered a backwater region. Those guys tend to gather in major nations like Faubrey.”
Though… it’s possible some of them were lurking in Melromarc as well.

…Come to think of it, even in the first world, there were adventurers who picked fights with me just because I was a hero. Perhaps, without realizing it, I may have ended up taking them down due to the level gap and other factors.
“So, we should head to this Dracia Mountain Range?”
“The deadline is approaching, so I suggest going there as soon as possible.”
“But we don’t have enough people to raise them, I say.”
We haven’t secured Yuki-chan and the others yet, not to mention the sister’s older sister and her group. Is it really okay to set off under these circumstances?
“Portals can’t be used in activation regions.”

“So that means we need to prepare before leaving, right? If there’s not much time left, maybe we should go with whatever forces we can gather today or tomorrow, strengthen ourselves first, and then work on reinforcing our forces afterward.”
“That makes sense. Our priority should be strengthening ourselves first.”
“Right. It looks like we have less time than we thought.”

The discussion seems to be coming together. Well, if Father and the others can gain enough strength in a week, it’ll definitely make things easier. Right now, the scariest thing is the threat of assassins coming after us. There’s still no guarantee that the Three Hero Church won’t make a move at any moment.
